58:1: I began to speak the third parable, concerning the righteous and the chosen.
58:2: Blessed are you, righteous and chosen ones, for your portion is glorious.
58:3: The righteous will be in the light of the sun, and the chosen in the light of everlasting life. Their days of life have no end, and the holy ones have no count of days.
58:4: They will seek the light and find righteousness with the Lord of Spirits. Peace to the righteous in the name of the Lord of the world!
58:5: After this the holy ones in heaven will be told to seek the hidden things of righteousness, the portion of faith, for it has risen like the sun upon dry land, and darkness has passed away.
58:6: There will be light that cannot be counted, and it will not be bounded by a number of days. For darkness was first examined, and light will stand firm before the Lord of Spirits. Upright light will stand firm for ever before the Lord of Spirits.
59:1: In those days my eyes saw the hidden things of the lightnings and lights, and their judgment. They flash for blessing and for curse, as the Lord of Spirits wills.
59:2: There I saw the hidden things of thunder, how it crashes in the heights of heaven, and its voices are heard. He showed me dwelling places of dry land [and the voice of thunder], for peace and blessing, or for curse, by the word of the Lord of Spirits.
59:3: After this all their hidden things were shown to me, those of the lights and lightnings: they flash for blessing and abundance.
60:1: In the five-hundredth year, in the seventh month, on the fourteenth day of the month, in the life of Enoch, I saw in that vision how the heaven of heavens shook with a great shaking. The host of the Most High and angels, myriads of myriads and ten-thousands of ten-thousands, were greatly troubled.
60:2: The Head of Days was sitting on the throne of his glory, and angels and righteous ones were standing around him.
60:3: A great trembling took hold of me, and fear seized me. My loins were racked, my whole being came loose, and I fell on my face.
60:4: Michael sent another angel from among the holy ones and raised me up. When he raised me, my spirit returned, for I could not bear the sight of that host, that tumult and shaking of heaven.
60:5: Michael said to me, “What have you seen that has so troubled you? Until today the day of mercy has remained, and he has been merciful and slow to anger toward those who dwell on dry land.”
60:6: “When the day, the power, the punishment and the judgment come, which the Lord of Spirits has prepared for those who do not bow to righteous judgment, who deny righteous judgment and take his name in vain—that day has been prepared as an oath for the chosen and an inquiry for sinners…”
60:7: On that day the two great beasts were separated: the female beast, whose name is Leviathan, to dwell in the depths of the sea above the springs of water.
60:8: The male is named Behemoth. With his breast he takes possession of an unseen wilderness, whose name is Dundayin, east of the garden where the chosen and righteous dwell, where my forefather was received, the seventh from Adam, the first of the people whom the Lord of Spirits made.
60:9: I asked the other angel to show me the power of the two great beasts, how they were separated in one day and placed in the depths of the sea and in the dry wilderness.
60:10: He said to me, “You, son of man, seek here to know what is hidden.”
60:11: The other angel who was walking with me and showing me things spoke to me. He showed me first and last in heaven, in the height of heaven, beneath dry land in the deep, at the ends of heaven and at heaven’s foundation.
60:12: And the storehouses of winds, how the winds are divided and weighed; they count the springs of winds according to the force of the wind, and their force according to the light of the moon, and according to the force of righteousness. The stars are divided, each by name, and every division is divided.
60:13: And thunder in its falling, and in the division that is divided with lightning, so that they flash, and their troops, so that they quickly obey.
60:14: For thunder has resting places; at the hearing of its voice it is given. Neither thunder nor lightning is separated, nor from it; the two go by the wind and are not separated.
60:15: When lightning flashes, thunder gives its voice, and the wind rests peacefully, and by it he divides between them. For the treasury of their number is of sand, and each of them is held with a bridle and turns by the force of the wind, and is driven in this way according to the skill surrounding the earth.
60:16: The wind of the sea is male and strong. According to its force, strength returns with a bridle; in this way it is driven and scattered through all the mountains of the earth.
60:17: The wind of frost is its own angel, and the wind of hail is a good angel.
60:18: The wind of rime is alive because of its strength. It has a wind of its own; what rises from it is like smoke, and its name is cold.
60:19: The wind of mist does not join them in their storehouses, but has a storehouse of its own, for its course is in glory, in light and darkness, in winter and summer; and its storehouse is an angel.
60:20: The wind of dew has its dwelling at the ends of heaven and adjoins the storehouses of rain. Its course is in winter and summer. The rain cloud and the cloud of mist join together, and one gives to the other.
60:21: When the wind of rain is stirred from its storehouse, angels come and open the storehouse and bring it out. When it is scattered over all dry land, it joins the water on dry land; and whenever it joins the water on dry land… [The conclusion is missing in the selected text.]
60:22: For water is for those who dwell on dry land; it is nourishment for dry land from the Most High who is in heaven. Therefore rain has a measure, and the angels receive it.
60:23: I saw all these things as far as the garden of the righteous.
60:24: The angel of peace who was walking with me said to me, “These two great beasts were prepared by the hand of God; he will provide food… [so that the punishment of the Lord of Spirits, when it kills children with their mothers and children with their fathers].”
60:25: When the punishment of the Lord of Spirits rests upon them, it will rest so that the punishment of the Lord of Spirits does not come in vain. It will kill children with their mothers and children with their fathers. [When the punishment of the Lord of Spirits rests upon these,] afterward judgment will be in mercy and patience.
61:1: In those days I saw that long cords were given to those angels. They took wings for themselves, flew, and went toward the north.
61:2: I asked the angel, “Why have these taken cords and gone?” He said to me, “They have gone to measure.”
61:3: The angel who was walking with me said to me, “These will bring the measures of the righteous and the bonds of the righteous to the righteous, so that they may lean upon the name of the Lord of Spirits for ever and ever.”
61:4: “They will measure, and the chosen will dwell with the chosen. These measures will be given for faith, and they will strengthen righteousness.”
61:5: “These measures will reveal all the hidden things in the depth of the earth: those who perished in the wilderness, those devoured by wild beasts and those devoured by the fish of the sea, so that they may return and find support on the day of the chosen one. Nothing perishes before the Lord of Spirits, and nothing can perish.”
61:6: All those in the height of heaven received a command, and power, a voice and a light like fire.
61:7: With that first voice they will bless, exalt and praise in wisdom; they will show wisdom in speech and in the spirit of life.
61:8: The Lord of Spirits seated the chosen one upon the throne of glory. He will judge all the works of the holy ones in the height of heaven, and their works will be weighed in the balance.
61:9: When he raises his face to judge their ways, those of the chosen, by the word of the name of the Lord of Spirits, and their tracks in the way of righteous judgment of the Lord of Spirits, all of them will speak with a voice and bless, praise, exalt and sanctify the name of the Lord of Spirits.
61:10: He will call all the host of the heavens, all the holy ones on high, the host of God, the cherubim, seraphim and ophanim, all the angels of power, all the angels of dominions, the chosen, and the other host on dry land and upon water.
61:11: On that day they will take up one voice and bless, praise and exalt in the spirit of faith, the spirit of wisdom, the spirit of patience, the spirit of mercy, the spirit of judgment and peace, and the spirit of goodness. All of them will say with one voice, “Blessed be the name of the Lord of Spirits, and may it be blessed for ever and ever.”
61:12: All who do not sleep in the height of heaven will bless him. All the holy ones in heaven will bless him, and all the chosen who dwell in the garden of life. Every spirit of light that can bless, praise, exalt and sanctify your blessed name, and all flesh, beyond its strength, will praise and bless your name for ever and ever.
61:13: For the Lord of Spirits is rich in mercy and slow to anger. All the work and every measure that he has made he revealed to the righteous and the chosen, in the name of the Lord of Spirits.
